| `buildings.<key>.size`    | `object`             | yes      |         |                                           | its footprint in cells, from its Position (the north-west cell)                                             |
| `buildings.<key>.size.w`  | `integer`            | yes      |         | 1 to 16                                   | width in cells, west to east                                                                                |
| `buildings.<key>.size.h`  | `integer`            | yes      |         | 1 to 16                                   | height in cells, north to south                                                                             |
| `buildings.<key>.work`    | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | construction work to finish it (build time: work / the workers' rates)                                      |
| `buildings.<key>.cost`    | `{ <key>: integer }` | no       | `{}`    | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`  | what one costs, paid from the faction stockpile: item id -> count                                           |
| `buildings.<key>.trains`  | `string[]`           | no       | `[]`    | items: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | the unit types it can train, once finished                                                                  |
| `buildings.<key>.dropoff` | `boolean`            | no       | `false` |                                           | whether gatherers can drop resources here, once finished                                                    |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/rts-types.json`):

```json
{
  "units": {
    "worker": {
      "health": 20,
      "speed": 3,
      "attack": 1,
      "range": 1,
      "cooldown": 4,
      "sight": 5,
      "cost": { "gold": 50 },
      "trainTicks": 30,
      "work": 2,
      "gather": { "capacity": 5, "ticks": 4 }
    },
    "soldier": {
      "health": 40,
      "speed": 3,
      "attack": 5,
      "range": 1,
      "cooldown": 6,
      "sight": 6,
      "cost": { "gold": 60 },
      "trainTicks": 45
    }
  },
  "buildings": {
    "hall": { "health": 600, "size": { "w": 3, "h": 3 }, "work": 300, "trains": ["worker"], "dropoff": true },
    "barracks": {
      "health": 300,
      "size": { "w": 2, "h": 2 },
      "work": 120,
      "cost": { "gold": 100 },
      "trains": ["soldier"]
    }
  }
}
```

### `campaign`

A campaign: the order a game plays its levels, missions and world scenarios in, as a list of level, mission and scenario ids (a scenario with the ticks it is played), with an optional entry to start at.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.campaign`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                | Type       | Required | Default | Limits                             | Description                                                                                                                                          |
| -------------------- | ---------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `version`            | `1`        | yes      |         |                                    | the campaign format version: 1                                                                                                                       |
| `id`                 | `string`   | yes      |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`     | the campaign id; the same as the file name                                                                                                           |
| `title`              | `string`   | no       |         | not empty                          | one line naming the campaign                                                                                                                         |
| `entries`            | `object[]` | yes      |         | at least 1 item                    | the play order: `{ "level": id }`, `{ "mission": id }` or `{ "scenario": id, "ticks": n }` each, every named level, mission and scenario in the game |
| `entries[].level`    | `string`   | no       |         | not empty                          | a level id (the level file name)                                                                                                                     |
| `entries[].mission`  | `string`   | no       |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`     | a mission id (the `*.mission.json` file name)                                                                                                        |
| `entries[].scenario` | `string`   | no       |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | a world scenario id (Engine 0.13): the file name of a content file in the `worlds-within/scenario` format                                            |
| `entries[].ticks`    | `integer`  | no       |         | >= 1                               | with `scenario` only (and required there): how many world ticks the scenario is played                                                               |
| `entries[].title`    | `string`   | no       |         | not empty                          | one line naming the entry for a page (Engine 0.13 T8), e.g. a scenario's name                                                                        |
| `start`              | `string`   | no       |         | not empty                          | the id of the entry played first; the first entry when left out                                                                                      |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/campaign.json`):

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "id": "main",
  "title": "The first chapter",
  "entries": [
    { "level": "level-1" },
    { "level": "level-2" },
    { "mission": "raid" },
    { "scenario": "village", "ticks": 400 },
    { "level": "level-3" }
  ],
  "start": "level-1"
}
```

### `mission`

A mission: its event, fixed world-time cost, the mini game it is played with, its params and its declared outcomes with delegation weights and effects.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.mission`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                | Type                                                           | Required | Default | Limits                                                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                 | `string`                                                       | yes      |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                         | the mission id; the same as the file name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `title`              | `string`                                                       | yes      |         | not empty                                              | shown when the mission is offered                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `event`              | `string`                                                       | no       |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                         | the event it belongs to, held frozen while it is open; none freezes nothing                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `worldTimeCost`      | `integer`                                                      | yes      |         | >= 1                                                   | world ticks between opening and the commit, fixed when it opens (whole number, at least 1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `play`               | `string`                                                       | no       |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                         | the mini game (or kit round) a player plays it with; left out, the mission is a choice that is only delegated                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `params`             | `{ <key>: JSON }`                                              | no       |         |                                                        | data handed to the mini game, checked by its params schema                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `outcomes`           | `object[]`                                                     | yes      |         | at least 1 item                                        | the declared outcome space, in the order delegation walks it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `outcomes[].id`      | `string`                                                       | yes      |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                         | the outcome id, unique in the mission; a kit report names it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `outcomes[].title`   | `string`                                                       | yes      |         | not empty                                              | a short line for a report card, e.g. "Two of three burnt"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `outcomes[].weight`  | `integer`                                                      | no       | `1`     | >= 1                                                   | its share when the mission is delegated (whole number, at least 1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `outcomes[].effects` | `(object \| object \| object \| object \| object \| object)[]` | no       | `[]`    |                                                        | the world changes it makes at the commit, in this order, each told apart by `type`: `damage` `{ entity, amount, fromReport? }`, `destroy` `{ entity }`, `inventory` `{ entity, item, add }`, `set` `{ entity, component, values }`, `opportunity` `{ open }` or `{ close }`, `fate` `{ entity, fate, by?, at? }` (`fate` injured, captured, freed or dead; `at`, a cell `{ x, y }`, on freed only and required there); `entity` is a scenario key or an entity id |
| `onQuit`             | `string`                                                       | yes      |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                         | the outcome a played mission commits when the player quits                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `playable`           | `string[]`                                                     | no       |         | at least 1 item; items: matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | the outcomes a player can reach by playing; all of them when left out                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/mission.json`):

```json
{
  "id": "raid",
  "title": "Burn the siege engines",
  "event": "siege",
  "worldTimeCost": 30,
  "play": "sabotage",
  "params": { "engines": 3 },
  "onQuit": "repelled",
  "outcomes": [
    {
      "id": "clean",
      "title": "All three burnt",
      "weight": 1,
      "effects": [
        { "type": "destroy", "entity": "ram" },
        { "type": "destroy", "entity": "tower" }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "partial",
      "title": "Two of three burnt",
      "weight": 2,
      "effects": [
        { "type": "destroy", "entity": "ram" },
        { "type": "damage", "entity": "tower", "amount": 20 }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "repelled",
      "title": "Driven off",
      "weight": 1,
      "effects": [
        { "type": "inventory", "entity": "camp", "item": "oil", "add": -2 },
        { "type": "opportunity", "open": "rescue" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### `palette`

A named list of colours (#rgb or #rrggbb) that sprite indices pick from.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.palette`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field    | Type       | Required | Default | Limits                                                                | Description                                                                 |
| -------- | ---------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | `string`   | yes      |         | not empty                                                             | the palette name sprites give in `palette`                                  |
| `colors` | `string[]` | yes      |         | 1 to 36 items; items: matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | the colours, "#rgb" or "#rrggbb"; a sprite index picks one (0 is the first) |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/palette.json`):

```json
{ "id": "hero", "colors": ["#000000", "#00a800", "#fca044", "#fcfcfc"] }
```

### `sfx`

An MML sound effect: id, optional bpm and up to four voices.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.sfx`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field      | Type     | Required | Default | Limits          | Description                       |
| ---------- | -------- | -------- | ------- | --------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `id`       | `string` | yes      |         | not empty       | the sound id the game plays it by |
| `bpm`      | `number` | no       |         | &lt;= 1000; > 0 | tempo in beats per minute         |
| `pulse`    | `string` | no       |         |                 | the pulse channel's MML           |
| `pulse2`   | `string` | no       |         |                 | the second pulse channel's MML    |
| `triangle` | `string` | no       |         |                 | the triangle channel's MML        |
| `noise`    | `string` | no       |         |                 | the noise channel's MML           |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/sfx.json`):

```json
{ "id": "chime", "bpm": 240, "pulse": "v12 @1 l16 o5 c e g > c" }
```

### `skin`

How a backend shows a game: each kind as a sprite or mesh, tiles, event sounds and effects, the HUD.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.skin`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                               | Type                                          | Required | Default | Limits                                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `backend`                           | `string`                                      | yes      |         | not empty                                       | the backend it is for: `canvas2d`, `three` (meshes) or another backend name                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `sheets`                            | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | defaults for entries that leave a field out                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `sheets.sheet`                      | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | the sprite file for entries that name none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `sheets.palette`                    | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | the palette for entries that name none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `sheets.fallbackColor`              | `string`                                      | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | the box colour for entries that give none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `kinds`                             | `{ <key>: object }`                           | yes      |         | keys: not empty                                 | entity kind -> how it looks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `kinds.<key>.sheet`                 | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 2D: the sprite file the frames are in (default `sheets.sheet`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `kinds.<key>.palette`               | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 2D: a palette to draw with instead of the sprite's own                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `kinds.<key>.frames`                | `{ <key>: string \| object }`                 | no       |         | keys: not empty                                 | 2D: animation state -> a frame name, `{ frames, ticks?, loop? }` (a cycle) or `{ up?, down?, left?, right?, up-left?, up-right?, down-left?, down-right? }` (a frame or cycle per facing, all optional; a diagonal left out uses its horizontal part); `idle` is used for a state not listed |
| `kinds.<key>.flipFacing`            | `boolean`                                     | no       |         |                                                 | 2D: draw the right-hand frames mirrored when the entity faces left or a left-hand diagonal                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `kinds.<key>.size`                  | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | 2D: the drawn size, when it is not the frame size                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `kinds.<key>.size.w`                | `integer`                                     | yes      |         | >= 1                                            | width in pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `kinds.<key>.size.h`                | `integer`                                     | yes      |         | >= 1                                            | height in pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `kinds.<key>.fallbackColor`         | `string`                                      | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | 2D: the box colour when a frame is missing (default `sheets.fallbackColor`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `kinds.<key>.mesh`                  | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 3D: a primitive (`box`, `wedge`, `cylinder`, `cone`, `sphere`, `plane`) or a key of `meshes`                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `kinds.<key>.color`                 | `string`                                      | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | 3D: the mesh's colour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `kinds.<key>.scale`                 | `number`                                      | no       |         | > 0                                             | 3D: size factor about the box's bottom centre (default 1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `kinds.<key>.depth`                 | `number`                                      | no       |         | > 0                                             | 3D: a primitive mesh's thickness in px (default: the box's width; a tile is one tile deep)                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `kinds.<key>.z`                     | `number`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | 3D: px toward the camera from the depth plane (default 0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `kinds.<key>.offset`                | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | where the sprite or mesh sits from the entity box's top-left corner                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `kinds.<key>.offset.x`              | `integer`                                     | yes      |         |                                                 | pixels right                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `kinds.<key>.offset.y`              | `integer`                                     | yes      |         |                                                 | pixels down                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag`                 | `object[]`                                    | no       |         |                                                 | looks by entity tag, `{ tag, sheet?, palette?, frames?, fallbackColor?, mesh?, color? }`: the first entry whose tag the entity has replaces those fields of the kind's; the state and facing are then picked as usual                                                                        |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].tag`           | `string`                                      | yes      |         | not empty                                       | the entity tag it is for (`used`, `look:door`, `site`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].sheet`         | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 2D: the sprite file (default the kind's)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].palette`       | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 2D: a palette to draw with (default the kind's)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].frames`        | `{ <key>: string \| object }`                 | no       |         | keys: not empty                                 | 2D: the frames by animation state, as the kind's `frames`, used instead of them                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].fallbackColor` | `string`                                      | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | 2D: the box colour when a frame is missing (default the kind's)                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].mesh`          | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 3D: a primitive (`box`, `wedge`, `cylinder`, `cone`, `sphere`, `plane`) or a key of `meshes`                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].color`         | `string`                                      | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | 3D: the mesh's colour (default the kind's)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `tiles`                             | `{ <key>: object }`                           | no       |         | keys: not empty                                 | map tile character or id -> how it looks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `tiles.<key>.sheet`                 | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 2D: the sprite file (default `sheets.sheet`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `tiles.<key>.frame`                 | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 2D: the frame name in the sheet                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `tiles.<key>.fallbackColor`         | `string`                                      | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | 2D: the colour when the frame is missing (default `sheets.fallbackColor`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `tiles.<key>.mesh`                  | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 3D: a primitive (`box`, `wedge`, `cylinder`, `cone`, `sphere`, `plane`) or a key of `meshes`                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `tiles.<key>.color`                 | `string`                                      | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | 3D: the mesh's colour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `tiles.<key>.depth`                 | `number`                                      | no       |         | > 0                                             | 3D: a primitive mesh's thickness in px (default: the box's width; a tile is one tile deep)                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `tiles.<key>.z`                     | `number`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | 3D: px toward the camera from the depth plane (default 0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `events`                            | `{ <key>: object }`                           | no       |         | keys: not empty                                 | event type -> its sound and effect; a key may match a field too: `type:value` (the `result` field, `mini-game-end:pass`) or `type:field=value`, tried first in file order, then the bare type                                                                                                |
| `events.<key>.sound`                | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | a song or sfx id to play                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `events.<key>.effect`               | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | a presentation-only effect at the event                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `events.<key>.effect.kind`          | `"flash" \| "particles" \| "shake" \| "tint"` | yes      |         |                                                 | what the backend shows                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `events.<key>.effect.color`         | `string`                                      | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | its colour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `events.<key>.effect.ticks`         | `integer`                                     | no       |         | >= 1                                            | how long it lasts                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `events.<key>.effect.count`         | `integer`                                     | no       |         | >= 1                                            | particles: how many                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `events.<key>.effect.size`          | `number`                                      | no       |         | > 0                                             | particles: size in pixels; shake: strength                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `hud`                               | `object[]`                                    | no       |         |                                                 | status values drawn on screen, in order                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `hud[].status`                      | `string`                                      | yes      |         | not empty                                       | the status key it shows (`health`, `score`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `hud[].as`                          | `"hearts" \| "number" \| "text" \| "icon"`    | yes      |         |                                                 | how it shows                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `hud[].x`                           | `integer`                                     | yes      |         |                                                 | left edge, screen pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `hud[].y`                           | `integer`                                     | yes      |         |                                                 | top edge, screen pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `hud[].sheet`                       | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | the sprite file for hearts and icons (default `sheets.sheet`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `hud[].frame`                       | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | the frame for hearts and icons                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `hud[].font`                        | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | the font for numbers and text                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `camera`                            | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | framing defaults; a frame's own camera hint wins                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `camera.zoom`                       | `number`                                      | no       |         | > 0                                             | scale factor (default 1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `camera.follow`                     | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | the entity kind or id to keep in view                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `camera.deadzone`                   | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | a box round the screen centre the followed entity moves in freely                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `camera.deadzone.w`                 | `integer`                                     | yes      |         | >= 0                                            | width in pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `camera.deadzone.h`                 | `integer`                                     | yes      |         | >= 0                                            | height in pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `camera.lerp`                       | `number`                                      | no       |         | 0 to 1                                          | how far the camera closes the gap each frame (1 snaps)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `camera.clamp`                      | `boolean`                                     | no       |         |                                                 | keep the view inside the map, centring a smaller map (default true); false lets a camera hint place it                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `meshes`                            | `{ <key>: object[] }`                         | no       |         | keys: not empty                                 | 3D: named compound meshes, each a list of primitive parts in world px                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `camera3d`                          | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | 3D: perspective framing and light defaults                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `camera3d.fov`                      | `number`                                      | no       |         | 1 to 179                                        | vertical field of view, degrees (default 45)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `camera3d.tilt`                     | `number`                                      | no       |         | -45 to 45                                       | pitch, degrees; positive looks down a little (default 0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `camera3d.layerDepth`               | `number`                                      | no       |         | >= 0                                            | px toward the camera per entity `layer` (default 16)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `camera3d.lights`                   | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | kept minimal: ambient plus one directional light                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `camera3d.lights.ambient`           | `number`                                      | no       |         | >= 0                                            | ambient light intensity (default 0.6)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `camera3d.lights.directional`       | `number`                                      | no       |         | >= 0                                            | the one directional light's intensity (default 0.8)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/skin.json`):

```json
{
  "backend": "canvas2d",
  "sheets": { "sheet": "hero", "palette": "hero", "fallbackColor": "#00a800" },
  "kinds": {
    "hero": {
      "frames": {
        "idle": { "down": "down-0", "up": "up-0", "right": "side-0" },
        "walk": {
          "down": { "frames": ["down-0", "down-1"], "ticks": 8 },
          "right": { "frames": ["side-0", "side-1"], "ticks": 8 }
        },
        "hurt": "hurt"
      },
      "flipFacing": true
    },
    "bat": {
      "sheet": "bat",
      "frames": { "fly": { "frames": ["a", "b"], "ticks": 6 } },
      "fallbackColor": "#a800a8"
    }
  },
  "tiles": { "#": { "sheet": "walls", "frame": "wall", "fallbackColor": "#7c7c7c" } },
  "events": {
    "hit": { "sound": "hurt", "effect": { "kind": "flash", "color": "#fcfcfc", "ticks": 4 } },
    "coin": { "sound": "coin" }
  },
  "hud": [
    { "status": "health", "as": "hearts", "x": 8, "y": 8, "sheet": "hud", "frame": "heart" },
    { "status": "score", "as": "number", "x": 200, "y": 8 }
  ],
  "camera": { "follow": "hero", "lerp": 0.25 }
}
```

### `song`

An MML song: id, bpm, loop and up to four channels.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.song`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field      | Type      | Required | Default | Limits          | Description                                             |
| ---------- | --------- | -------- | ------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | `string`  | yes      |         | not empty       | the song id rooms and scenes name it by                 |
| `bpm`      | `number`  | yes      |         | &lt;= 1000; > 0 | tempo in beats per minute                               |
| `loop`     | `boolean` | yes      |         |                 | start again at the `L` mark (or the start) when it ends |
| `pulse1`   | `string`  | no       |         |                 | the first pulse channel's MML                           |
| `pulse2`   | `string`  | no       |         |                 | the second pulse channel's MML                          |
| `triangle` | `string`  | no       |         |                 | the triangle channel's MML                              |
| `noise`    | `string`  | no       |         |                 | the noise channel's MML                                 |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/song.json`):

```json
{
  "id": "theme",
  "bpm": 120,
  "loop": true,
  "pulse1": "v10 @2 l8 o4 L [c e g > c < g e]2 d f a f",
  "triangle": "l4 o3 L [c g]2 d a"
}
```

### `sprite`

Text-grid pixel art: a palette name, an optional legend and named frames.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.sprite`
- Read from: `.json` or `.txt`

| Field          | Type                            | Required | Default | Limits          | Description                                                                           |
| -------------- | ------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `palette`      | `string`                        | yes      |         | not empty       | the id of the palette the indices pick from                                           |
| `legend`       | `{ <key>: "clear" \| integer }` | no       |         |                 | character -> "clear" or a palette index; without it rows use `.` and `0`-`9`, `a`-`z` |
| `legend.<key>` | `"clear" \| integer`            | no       |         |                 | "clear" (transparent) or a palette index 0-35                                         |
| `frames`       | `{ <key>: string[] }`           | yes      |         | keys: not empty | frame name -> its rows (a text grid)                                                  |
| `frames.<key>` | `string[]`                      | no       |         |                 | the rows: equal-width strings of legend characters                                    |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/sprite.txt`):

```text
; A 4x4 gem in two frames. Comments start with ";".
palette hero
legend . clear
legend k 0
legend g 1
legend w 3

frame idle
.kk.
kgwk
kggk
.kk.

frame shine
.kk.
kwgk
kggk
.kk.
```

### `level`

A platformer level: id, physics profile, scroll mode, spawns and bump-block contents, with its map in a text grid of the kit legend.

- Defined by: kit platformer
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.level`
- Read from: `.json` + `.map.txt`

| Field                 | Type                          | Required | Default   | Limits                                                                           | Description                                                                                                                           |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------- | -------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                  | `string`                      | yes      |           | not empty                                                                        | the level id: its file name                                                                                                           |
| `profile`             | `string`                      | yes      |           | not empty                                                                        | the physics profile it is played with: a `profile` id                                                                                 |
| `scroll`              | `"right" \| "free" \| "none"` | no       | `"right"` |                                                                                  | `right`: the camera only scrolls forward; `free`: both ways; `none`: it never scrolls                                                 |
| `size`                | `[integer, integer]`          | no       |           |                                                                                  | [columns, rows]; the size comes from the grid, and a size given here must match it                                                    |
| `spawns`              | `{ <key>: object }`           | no       | `{}`      |                                                                                  | spawn characters of the map (one character, not a legend one) by the actor they spawn                                                 |
| `spawns.<key>.actor`  | `string`                      | yes      |           | not empty                                                                        | the actor type it spawns, defined in the level's profile                                                                              |
| `spawns.<key>.facing` | `"left" \| "right"`           | no       | `"left"`  |                                                                                  | the way it starts moving                                                                                                              |
| `blocks`              | `string[]`                    | no       |           | items: matches `^(coin\|coins\|powerup\|life\|actor:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)$`           | what each bump block (?) holds, in reading order: coin, coins, powerup, life or actor:&lt;type>; all coins when left out              |
| `triggers`            | `object[]`                    | no       | `[]`      |                                                                                  | what each mini-game trigger (!) starts, in reading order: the mini game id, its params and the outcome of each result                 |
| `triggers[].game`     | `string`                      | yes      |           | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                                                   | the id of the mini game it starts, one the game supplies                                                                              |
| `triggers[].params`   | `{ <key>: JSON }`             | no       | `{}`      |                                                                                  | data for the mini game's round (its MiniGameContext.params)                                                                           |
| `triggers[].pass`     | `string[]`                    | no       | `[]`      | items: matches `^(coins:[1-9][0-9]*\|life\|clear\|respawn\|open:[0-9]+:[0-9]+)$` | what a pass does, in order: coins:&lt;n>, life, clear, respawn (on the trigger) or open:&lt;col>:&lt;row>; nothing when left out      |
| `triggers[].fail`     | `string[]`                    | no       | `[]`      | items: matches `^(coins:[1-9][0-9]*\|life\|clear\|respawn\|open:[0-9]+:[0-9]+)$` | what a fail does, in order: coins:&lt;n>, life, clear, respawn (on the trigger) or open:&lt;col>:&lt;row>; nothing when left out      |
| `triggers[].quit`     | `string[]`                    | no       | `[]`      | items: matches `^(coins:[1-9][0-9]*\|life\|clear\|respawn\|open:[0-9]+:[0-9]+)$` | what a quit does, in order: coins:&lt;n>, life, clear, respawn (on the trigger) or open:&lt;col>:&lt;row>; nothing when left out      |
| `triggers[].look`     | `string`                      | no       |           | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                                                   | how it looks (Engine 0.11, gap G13): presented as the tag `look:<id>` on the trigger's entity, for a skin's `byTag`; left out, no tag |
| `map`                 | `string[]`                    | yes      |           |                                                                                  | the level grid, top row first, of legend and spawn characters; usually in the `.map.txt` file                                         |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/level.json`):

```json
{
  "id": "tiny",
  "profile": "runner",
  "scroll": "right",
  "size": [24, 8],
  "spawns": { "w": { "actor": "walker" } },
  "blocks": ["coin"]
}
```

With `docs/reference/examples/level.map.txt`:

```text
........................
........................
........................
.......?................
........................
..................o.....
.@.............w.##...G.
##########...###########
```

### `profile`

A platformer physics profile: player movement numbers and actor types in whole sub-pixel and 1/4096 px per tick units.

- Defined by: kit platformer
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.profile`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                        | Type                  | Required | Default | Limits                            | Description                                                                                            |
| ---------------------------- | --------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`                         | `string`              | yes      |         | not empty                         | the profile id: its file name (`runner.profile.json` is `runner`)                                      |
| `player`                     | `object`              | yes      |         |                                   | the player's movement numbers                                                                          |
| `player.box`                 | `object`              | yes      |         |                                   | the player's hit box in px                                                                             |
| `player.box.w`               | `integer`             | yes      |         | 1 to 64                           | width in px                                                                                            |
| `player.box.h`               | `integer`             | yes      |         | 1 to 64                           | height in px                                                                                           |
| `player.minWalk`             | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the speed a walk from rest starts at, in 1/4096 px per tick                                            |
| `player.walkAccel`           | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | acceleration while walking, in 1/4096 px per tick, each tick                                           |
| `player.runAccel`            | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | acceleration while running, in 1/4096 px per tick, each tick                                           |
| `player.friction`            | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | deceleration with no direction held, in 1/4096 px per tick, each tick                                  |
| `player.skid`                | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | deceleration while holding the way opposite to the motion (a skid), in 1/4096 px per tick, each tick   |
| `player.skidTurn`            | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | below this speed a skid turns the player round at once, in 1/4096 px per tick                          |
| `player.maxWalk`             | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the walking speed cap, in 1/4096 px per tick                                                           |
| `player.maxRun`              | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the running speed cap, in 1/4096 px per tick                                                           |
| `player.runHold`             | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | ticks the running cap lasts after run is let go                                                        |
| `player.jumps`               | `object[]`            | yes      |         | at least 1 item                   | jump tiers by take-off speed, slowest first: the first whose `below` \|vx\| is under                   |
| `player.jumps[].below`       | `integer`             | no       |         | >= 1                              | the \|vx\| at take-off this tier applies below (left out on the last tier), in 1/4096 px per tick      |
| `player.jumps[].speed`       | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the take-off speed upwards, in 1/4096 px per tick                                                      |
| `player.jumps[].holdGravity` | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | gravity while jump is held and the player still rises, in 1/4096 px per tick, each tick                |
| `player.jumps[].gravity`     | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | gravity otherwise, in 1/4096 px per tick, each tick                                                    |
| `player.jumpBuffer`          | `integer`             | no       |         | 0 to 30                           | ticks a jump press is remembered until the player can jump (0 when left out)                           |
| `player.maxFall`             | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the fall speed cap, in 1/4096 px per tick                                                              |
| `player.fallReset`           | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the fall speed set when a fall goes over `maxFall`, in 1/4096 px per tick                              |
| `player.stompBounce`         | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the upward speed a stomp bounces the player with, in 1/4096 px per tick                                |
| `player.hp`                  | `integer`             | no       | `1`     | 1 to 99                           | the hit points (power level) the player starts with; a harm takes one, at 0 it dies                    |
| `player.maxHp`               | `integer`             | no       |         | 1 to 99                           | the most hit points a power-up can raise it to (`hp` when left out)                                    |
| `player.invulnTicks`         | `integer`             | no       | `0`     | >= 0                              | ticks after a harm in which the player cannot be harmed again                                          |
| `player.breakBricksAt`       | `integer`             | no       |         | >= 1                              | from this many hit points up a head bump breaks a brick; left out, bricks never break                  |
| `player.lives`               | `integer`             | no       | `1`     | 1 to 99                           | tries at the level: a death with a life left respawns the player at the start                          |
| `actorGravity`               | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | gravity on every actor, in 1/4096 px per tick, each tick                                               |
| `actorMaxFall`               | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | every actor's fall speed cap, in 1/4096 px per tick                                                    |
| `actors`                     | `{ <key>: object }`   | yes      |         | keys: matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` | actor types by generic name (`walker`, `shell`): lower-case letters, digits and "-"                    |
| `actors.<key>.box`           | `object`              | no       |         |                                   | the hit box in px (16x16 when left out)                                                                |
| `actors.<key>.box.w`         | `integer`             | yes      |         | 1 to 64                           | width in px                                                                                            |
| `actors.<key>.box.h`         | `integer`             | yes      |         | 1 to 64                           | height in px                                                                                           |
| `actors.<key>.speed`         | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | walking speed; 0 stands still, in 1/4096 px per tick                                                   |
| `actors.<key>.turnAt`        | `"walls" \| "ledges"` | yes      |         |                                   | `walls`: turns round at a wall; `ledges`: also at the edge of a drop                                   |
| `actors.<key>.stompable`     | `boolean`             | yes      |         |                                   | a stomp from above beats it (and bounces the player)                                                   |
| `actors.<key>.stompInto`     | `string`              | no       |         | not empty                         | the actor type a stomp turns it into; left out, a stomp defeats it                                     |
| `actors.<key>.kickable`      | `boolean`             | yes      |         |                                   | touching it while it stands still kicks it away                                                        |
| `actors.<key>.kickSpeed`     | `integer`             | no       |         | >= 0                              | the speed a kick sends it at; required when kickable, in 1/4096 px per tick                            |
| `actors.<key>.harms`         | `boolean`             | yes      |         |                                   | touching it (other than a stomp or a kick) harms the player                                            |
| `actors.<key>.kickGrace`     | `integer`             | no       |         | 0 to 120                          | ticks after a kick (or a stomp that makes it) in which it does not touch the player (15 when left out) |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/profile.json`):

```json
{
  "id": "runner",
  "player": {
    "box": { "w": 12, "h": 16 },
    "minWalk": 304,
    "walkAccel": 152,
    "runAccel": 228,
    "friction": 208,
    "skid": 416,
    "skidTurn": 2304,
    "maxWalk": 6400,
    "maxRun": 10496,
    "runHold": 10,
    "jumps": [
      { "below": 4096, "speed": 16384, "holdGravity": 512, "gravity": 1792 },
      { "below": 9472, "speed": 16384, "holdGravity": 480, "gravity": 1536 },
      { "speed": 20480, "holdGravity": 640, "gravity": 2304 }
    ],
    "jumpBuffer": 4,
    "maxFall": 18432,
    "fallReset": 16384,
    "stompBounce": 16384,
    "hp": 2,
    "maxHp": 2,
    "invulnTicks": 150,
    "breakBricksAt": 2,
    "lives": 3
  },
  "actorGravity": 1024,
  "actorMaxFall": 16384,
  "actors": {
    "walker": { "speed": 2048, "turnAt": "walls", "stompable": true, "kickable": false, "harms": true },
    "shell-walker": {
      "box": { "w": 16, "h": 24 },
      "speed": 2048,
      "turnAt": "walls",
      "stompable": true,
      "stompInto": "shell",
      "kickable": false,
      "harms": true
    },
    "shell": {
      "speed": 0,
      "turnAt": "walls",
      "stompable": true,
      "stompInto": "shell",
      "kickable": true,
      "kickSpeed": 12288,
      "harms": true
    }
  }
}
```

### `rts-map`

An RTS map: a world scenario with the rts system set (terrain text grids, units, buildings, resource nodes).

- Defined by: kit rts
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.rts-map`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                             | Type                                                       | Required | Default | Limits                                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `format`                          | `"worlds-within/scenario"`                                 | yes      |         |                                                            | always `worlds-within/scenario`                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `version`                         | `1`                                                        | yes      |         |                                                            | the scenario format version                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `seed`                            | `integer`                                                  | yes      |         |                                                            | the world's seed                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `systems`                         | `"rts"`                                                    | yes      |         |                                                            | always `rts`: the RTS units and economy                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `terrain`                         | `object`                                                   | yes      |         |                                                            | the terrain grid                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `terrain.legend`                  | `{ <key>: object }`                                        | yes      |         | keys: not empty; length &lt;= 1                            | one ground type per grid character                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `terrain.legend.<key>.name`       | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                         | the ground type name                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `terrain.legend.<key>.cost`       | `integer`                                                  | yes      |         | >= 1                                                       | ticks to enter a cell of this type                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `terrain.legend.<key>.passable`   | `boolean`                                                  | yes      |         |                                                            | false: nothing can enter it                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `terrain.rows`                    | `string[]`                                                 | yes      |         | at least 1 item; items: not empty                          | the grid, one string per row, north first                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `terrain.elevation`               | `string[]`                                                 | yes      |         | items: matches `^[0-9]+$`                                  | one elevation digit (0-9) per cell, the same size as `rows`                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `entities`                        | `object[]`                                                 | no       | `[]`    |                                                            | units, buildings, resource nodes, stockpiles and the types table, spawned in this order                                                                                                                                                     |
| `entities[].key`                  | `string`                                                   | no       |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                         | a name other entities can `$ref`                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `entities[].components`           | `{ <key>: JSON }`                                          | yes      |         | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`                    | components by name, checked by the simulation when the world is built                                                                                                                                                                       |
